steps.command: item replace entity @s weapon.mainhand with water_bucket

setblock ~1 ~ ~2 minecraft:repeating_command_block{auto:1b,Command:"execute positioned ~-1 ~ ~-2 if block ~3 ~ ~ amendments:liquid_cauldron{sd_milk_mb:1000} run setblock ~2 ~ ~2 minecraft:cyan_concrete"} replace
item replace entity @s weapon.mainhand with air

execute align xz run summon minecraft:item ~3.5 ~1.2 ~0.5 {PickupDelay:20s,Item:{id:"minecraft:red_shulker_box",Count:1b,tag:{display:{Name:'{"text":"洗色测试"}'},BlockEntityTag:{Items:[{Slot:0b,id:"minecraft:diamond",Count:3b}]}}}}

setblock ~1 ~ ~2 repeating_command_block{auto:1b,Command:"execute if block ~2 ~ ~-2 amendments:liquid_cauldron{sd_milk_mb:750} if entity @e[type=item,distance=..6,nbt={Item:{id:\"minecraft:shulker_box\"}}] run setblock ~1 ~ ~ lime_concrete"}
setblock ~1 ~ ~2 repeating_command_block{auto:1b,Command:"execute if entity @p[distance=..4,nbt={Inventory:[{id:\"minecraft:shulker_box\"}]}] run setblock ~1 ~ ~ blue_concrete"}

execute if entity @s[nbt={Inventory:[{id:"minecraft:shulker_box",Count:1b,tag:{display:{Name:'{"text":"洗色测试"}'},BlockEntityTag:{Items:[{Slot:0b,id:"minecraft:diamond",Count:3b}]}}}]}] run setblock ~2 ~ ~2 purple_concrete
